steps.name: Install production Python 3.14 and pinned dev requirements
argv: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv && python3 -m venv /tmp/uv-bootstrap && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/pip install --quiet uv==0.10.2 && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.14 .venv && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python .venv -r requirements-dev.txt

steps.name: Boot the server and fetch health and home
argv: data=$(mktemp -d); OPENGLAZE_MODE=personal FLASK_HOST=127.0.0.1 FLASK_PORT=8768 DATABASE_PATH=$data/glaze.db .venv/bin/python server.py > $data/server.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid' EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8768/health && break; sleep 1; done; for path in /health /api/health /; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8768$path); echo "$path $code"; test "$code" = 200 || { cat $data/server.log; exit 1; }; done
